query: INSERT INTO app.idp_event_cursor (id, idp_realm, position_ms, last_pulled_at, updated_at) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5) ON CONFLICT (idp_realm) DO UPDATE SET position_ms = GREATEST(app.idp_event_cursor.position_ms, EXCLUDED.position_ms), last_pulled_at = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.last_pulled_at, app.idp_event_cursor.last_pulled_at), updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at
